closePathNote: The dispatch names the close _inbox/2026-08-18_b77_close.json and the hand-carried card names _inbox/2026-08-18_b_g77_close.json. Both paths are written with identical content rather than guessing which the planner reads. Flagged, not resolved by the lane.
missionPremise: _decisions/2026-08-18_template_city_becomes_fixture_city.md, active 2026-08-18: template-city becomes a fixture city carrying records generated from the adapter output contracts, empty-city keeps the honest-empty demonstration, and the five-part labelling gate is mechanical rather than editorial. The design reason is 30b law 3, quiet on satisfied and loud on unresolved: with zero records nothing is unresolved, every pill renders quiet, and the system's tension mechanism is switched off, so the design cannot be evaluated or reviewed.
completionPredicate: A stranger can check this without me: npm test is green including tests they did not write; web/shell.css and web/sc-kit.css are byte-identical to origin/main and the shell-top and shell-nav blocks in web/index.html are byte-identical; no CSS class was added; GET /?lens=development-services on template-city renders fourteen generated cases with unresolved rows first and the four tiles reading 3/5/4/2; the same URL with cityKey=empty-city renders honest-empty with a basis; every generated record carries origin fixture and fixture true in its payload; grantedAdapters is empty on all three packs; no city-owned asset record exists on any pack; each of the five labelling-gate items has a named test and each of those gates was watched fail.
scopeBasis: One lens deep on Development services, because the ruling asks for the product to demonstrate itself and the Pipeline queue is the surface where 30b law 3 either works or does not. Out of scope and deliberately so: G-52, any real adapter run or grant, G-24 asset records, live Bastrop, the other five Development services tabs, the Overview / Finance / Citizen lenses beyond the one live defect fix, and web/shell.css plus the shell-top and shell-nav blocks which lane B76 owns this wave. People and money columns are excluded from the queue by the card's own constraints, so the queue ships without them rather than with invented ones.

liveDefectFixed.finding: The hidden attribute is inert on any component web/shell.css gives an explicit display. .pill is inline-flex, .prov is inline-flex, .state is flex, and none of them carries a [hidden] rule, so el.hidden = true does nothing. This had already shipped: the Overview Public meetings panel rendered an amber Partial pill beside the words 'No meeting packet has been read', which is exactly the claim the code comment beside it says it exists to prevent.
liveDefectFixed.evidence: web/shell.css lines 688 and 716 carry .stage[hidden] and .stage-esc[hidden]; somebody hit this before and patched two components rather than the rule. Before and after screenshots are listed above.
liveDefectFixed.fix: one show(el, on) helper in web/app.js that sets the attribute and forces the display, used by every toggle, plus style="display:none" beside the attribute in the static markup so the pre-script state agrees. src/ui.test.mjs > 'hides through a mechanism that actually works on this kit' asserts every toggle routes through it, and was watched fail when one call was regressed to a bare .hidden assignment.
liveDefectFixed.properFixOwner: a single [hidden] { display: none } rule belongs in the kit, which is lane B76's file this wave. Recommend B76 or a follow-up card adds it and this helper stays as belt and braces.
